# polaris_semantic_models (Data Source)

Lists the semantic models of a namespace. Use `polaris_semantic_model` for the document of one. Requires the `ENABLE_SEMANTIC_MODELS` feature on the server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polaris_semantic_models" "sales" {
  catalog   = "lakehouse"
  namespace = ["sales"]
}

output "sales_semantic_models" {
  value = data.polaris_semantic_models.sales.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The name of the catalog.
- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace the semantic models are stored in, as an ordered list of levels.

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) Names of the semantic models, in the order returned by Polaris.
